name: httpx-browser-webext
description: WebExtension browser for httpx:// URLs (XEP-0332) — Firefox + Chromium

scripts.build: npm run build:lib && vite build && node scripts/make-manifests.mjs
scripts.package: npm run build && web-ext build --source-dir dist/firefox --artifacts-dir dist/artifacts --filename httpx-browser-firefox-{version}.zip --overwrite-dest && web-ext build --source-dir dist/chromium --artifacts-dir dist/artifacts --filename httpx-browser-chromium-{version}.zip --overwrite-dest && node scripts/make-source-archive.mjs
scripts.dev:chromium: echo 'Load dist/chromium via chrome://extensions → Load unpacked'
